```{r}
 
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggforce)
```

```{r}
# Summon filtered physeq object 
Final_path <- "/Users/oo21097/Desktop/MRES_Kimbe_Bay/Microbial_Data/Novogene_Results/00.CleanData/Final_Dada2"
kimbe_phyloseq_rare <- readRDS(file.path(Final_path, "kimbe_phyloseq_rare.rds"))

# Filter for sediment samples and transform data
kimbe_sediment <- subset_samples(kimbe_phyloseq_rare, SampleType == "S")
kimbe_sediment <- subset_samples(kimbe_sediment, sample_names(kimbe_sediment) != "KD17S_filtered.fastq.gz")

# Tax glom at Family level and prune rare taxa
kimbe_sediment_glom <- tax_glom(kimbe_sediment, taxrank = "Family", bad_empty = c(NA), NArm = TRUE)  



# Perform NMDS
nmds_kimbe_sediment <- ordinate(kimbe_sediment_glom, method = "NMDS", distance = "bray")

# Check NMDS stress
nmds_kimbe_sediment$stress  # Should ideally be < 0.2

# Create plotting dataframe
kimbe_nmds_df_sediment <- data.frame(
  NMDS1 = nmds_kimbe_sediment$points[,1],
  NMDS2 = nmds_kimbe_sediment$points[,2],
  Location = sample_data(kimbe_sediment_glom)$Location, 
  Depth = sample_data(kimbe_sediment_glom)$Depth
)

my_font <- "Verdana"
location_labels <- c("KA" = "Lagoon A", "KD" = "Lagoon D", "KE" = "Lagoon E", "KM" = "Control")
# Create enhanced NMDS plot
kimbe_nmds_plot_sediment <- ggplot(kimbe_nmds_df_sediment, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = Location, shape = Depth)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5)  +
   ggforce::geom_mark_ellipse(aes(fill = Location), expand = 0, alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
  scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Location", 
                       labels = location_labels) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Location", 
                       labels = location_labels) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = my_font),
    axis.text = element_text(family = my_font, size = 8, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(family = my_font, size = 11, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 1, fill = "transparent"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "",
    x = "NMDS1",
    y = "NMDS2"
  )
# Display and save the plot
print(kimbe_nmds_plot_sediment)

ggsave( "/Users/oo21097/Desktop/MRES_Kimbe_Bay/Microbial_Data/figures/Kimbe/kimbe_nmds_plot_water.png", plot = kimbe_nmds_plot_sediment, width = 8, height = 5  , dpi = 300)
save(kimbe_nmds_df_sediment, file = "kimbe_nmds_df_sediment.RData")
```

```{r}
which_outlier <- kimbe_nmds_df_sediment[which.max(abs(kimbe_nmds_df_sediment$NMDS1) + abs(kimbe_nmds_df_sediment$NMDS2)), ]
print(which_outlier)
library(phyloseq)
 KD17S <- plot_bar(prune_samples(rownames(which_outlier), kimbe_sediment), fill = "Class") +
  ggtitle("Taxonomic Composition of Outlier Sample") +
   coord_flip() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.2, "cm")
  )
```

```{r}
# Extract metadata
kimbe_metadata <- data.frame(sample_data(kimbe_sediment))

# Add sample names to metadata for easy filtering
kimbe_metadata$SampleName <- rownames(kimbe_metadata)

# Ensure the outlier_id is correct
outlier_id <- rownames(which_outlier)

# Select one normal sample from Location == "NN", excluding the outlier
normal_id <- kimbe_metadata %>%
  dplyr::filter(Location == "KD" & !(SampleName %in% outlier_id)) %>%
  dplyr::pull(SampleName) %>%
  .[1]  # Take the first one

# Now prune both samples using correct sample names
outlier_physeq <- prune_samples(outlier_id, kimbe_sediment)
normal_physeq  <- prune_samples(normal_id, kimbe_sediment)

# Merge and plot
both_samples <- merge_phyloseq(outlier_physeq, normal_physeq)

outlier<-plot_bar(both_samples, fill = "Class") +
  facet_wrap(~Sample, ncol = 2) +
  ggtitle("Taxonomic Composition: Outlier vs Normal Sample (KD)") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.2, "cm"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 6),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```


```{r}
library(vegan)
if (!requireNamespace("devtools", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("pmartinezarbizu/pairwiseAdonis/pairwiseAdonis")
library(pairwiseAdonis)

# Calculate Bray-Curtis distances
kimbe_bray_sediment <- phyloseq::distance(kimbe_sediment_glom, method = "bray")

# Extract sample data
kimbe_metadata_sediment <- data.frame(sample_data(kimbe_sediment_glom))

# PERMANOVA
kimbe_adonis2_result_sediment <- adonis2(kimbe_bray_sediment ~ Location * DepthCategory, data = kimbe_metadata_sediment, permutations = 999)

print(kimbe_adonis2_result_water)
```

```{r}
library(pairwiseAdonis)

# Run pairwise PERMANOVA for Location
pairwise.adonis2(
  kimbe_bray_sediment ~ Location,
  data = kimbe_metadata_sediment,
  permutations = 999,
  p.adjust.m = "bonferroni"  # adjust p-values for multiple testing
)

e# OR run pairwise PERMANOVA for DepthCategory
pairwise.adonis2(
  kimbe_bray_sediment ~ DepthCategory,
  data = kimbe_metadata_sediment,
  permutations = 999,
  p.adjust.m = "bonferroni"
)

# OR for Location × DepthCategory interaction
kimbe_metadata_sediment$Group <- interaction(kimbe_metadata_sediment$Location, kimbe_metadata_sediment$DepthCategory)

pairwise.adonis2(
  kimbe_bray_sediment ~ Group,
  data = kimbe_metadata_sediment,
  permutations = 999,
  p.adjust.m = "bonferroni"
)

```
